description: This file is a C++ source file implementing the USBMassStorage plugin for WPEFramework. It defines the class USBMassStorage, handles device mount/unmount notifications, and manages plugin lifecycle including initialization and deinitialization.

classes.name: USBMassStorage
classes.description: Main class implementing the USB mass storage plugin, managing device notifications, lifecycle, and interactions with the WPEFramework.

classes.name: USBMassStorage::Notification
classes.description: Nested class handling device mounted and unmounted notifications.

methods.name: USBMassStorage::Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, sets up device interfaces, and registers for notifications.

methods.name: USBMassStorage::Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources, unregisters notifications, and releases interfaces.

methods.name: USBMassStorage::Information
methods.description: Returns a string describing the plugin's purpose.
